## Problem and outcome

Describe the user-visible problem and the resulting behaviour. Link the `MVP-*`/`AC-*` items, the feature plan and any `D-*`, `P-*` or ADR this change touches.

## Scope and risk

Name the affected modules and audiences (office, driver, platform team). Explain any change to tenant or scope access, personal data, files, imports/exports, UDA definitions, settings figures or the database schema. Write "not applicable" where it is.

## Verification

List the checks actually run and their results. Link evidence for the acceptance criteria. Name anything not tested and why. Documentation-only changes check links, consistency and sourced claims.

## Release and recovery

Describe migration, configuration, compatibility, rollout and recovery when applicable. List unresolved decisions that affect release. Do not imply that merging deploys anything unless a configured workflow does so.
